column2: Every raw clip gets logged in Raw Assets the SAME day it's shot.
Nothing goes live without a hook in the first 3 seconds and a CTA at the end.
Calendar is filled 2 weeks ahead at all times. Never post reactively (except trends).
Reels-first. If in doubt make it a Reel not a static post.
One person = one owner per post. No orphan tasks.
Reply to every comment in the first 60 minutes after posting (boosts reach).
Save all final exports in the shared Drive folder named by post ID.
